name: Do I need to upgrade my main water line during a whole-house remodel?
description: An upgrade to your main water line may be needed during a whole-house remodel if you're adding many new fixtures or increasing water demand.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to upgrade my main water line during a whole-house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might need to upgrade your main water line during a whole-house remodel, especially if you are adding multiple new bathrooms, a larger kitchen, or high-demand fixtures like rain showers. Older homes often have smaller diameter water lines that may not adequately support increased water usage. A plumber can assess your current system and proposed changes to determine if an upgrade is necessary to maintain sufficient water pressure and flow throughout your renovated home.
